dct_title_s: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) - Spatial Distribution of Population (2015-2030)
dct_description_sm: Estimates, total number of people per grid-cell. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are number of people per pixel. The mapping approach is Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution. More information can be found in the [Release Statement](https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/Global_2015_2030/R2025A/doc/Global2_Release_Statement_R2025A_v1.pdf) Please note that these data represent 2025 Alpha release versions, constructed in September 2025
